hints: When the 4 kg block moves left, which way does the 2 kg block go? Then list every friction on the 4 kg block.
worded:
1. The string runs from the 2 kg block round the wall pulley to the 4 kg block. If the 4 kg block moves left, the 2 kg block moves right: they slip against each other.

2. 2 kg block, on the verge: T = 0.1 × 20 = 2 N.

3. 4 kg block: F must beat T (the string pulls it right), the 2 kg block’s friction on it (2 N, right) and the floor’s friction 0.2 × 60 = 12 N (right).

4. F = 2 + 2 + 12 = 16 N. (D)
mistakes: The floor’s normal force carries both blocks (60 N).
The block-on-block friction acts on both blocks, so it appears twice in total (in T and on the 4 kg block).
